segments.name: Vuzix Corporation
products: M400 and M4000 Smart Glasses (M Series)
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells AI-enabled smart glasses, waveguide optics and display engines for enterprise, medical, defense, security and select consumer applications.
segments.evidence: The Company does not operate any material separate lines of business or separate business entities and therefore manages its operations as a single operating segment and therefore a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including enterprises, ODMs and OEMs, pay for Vuzix-branded smart glasses, custom optical display solutions and engineering services.
